clara: Heads-up 1 I'm drafting a short playbook entry for prefetch heuristics when using q4-family quant profiles. Goal: clear, copy-pasteable guidance for SDK users and a short migration note.

tom: Nice. Can you outline the scopes you'll cover? e.g., when to disable prefetch, recommended microbatch settings, and CI checks?

clara: Exactly. Plan sections: 1) problem statement (1-2 lines), 2) quick presets (short-prefix, long-stream, embeddings), 3) JS + Python snippets, 4) troubleshooting checklist, 5) links to perf artifacts.

anika: Please include an explicit example showing the `heuristic` toggle so users can re-enable adaptive prefetch after rolling out. Also show how to do it via the Console and SDK.

clara: Yup. Example snippet (Python) I will include: ```py
# short-prefix safe preset
client.optimize.configure(
  model='redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  batching={'strategy': 'microbatch', 'max_batch_ms': 8},
  cache={'prefetch': {'enabled': False}}
)
```

tom: Add the JS version too and a tiny note: for long streaming workloads, `prefetch: true` remains better for throughput unless you observe first-token jitter.

anika: Also add a short test recommendation: run `examples/optimize/prefetch-smoke --profile=q4_fast` and assert p95 < 120ms for first-token after warmup. We'll link the CI job.

clara: Good call. I'll create the example dir and a smoke script. I'll attach perf job 2145 and point to csv artifact.

devex-bot: Reminder: docs snippet must pass code-lint and include both language variants.

tom: For wording, keep it neutral: "If you see first-token jitter, try disabling prefetch for q4_fast and test throughput impact." Avoid saying it's a bug.

anika: We should also warn about tokenizer-induced short-prefix inflation and link the tokenization note in the Optimize guide.

clara: Drafted PR branch `docs/prefetch-playbook-2987654321`. Labels: `docs:optimize-playbook`, `needs-ml-review`, `needs-devex`. Will ping ML and DevEx for review.

tom: Add a tiny changelog bullet under Optimize v2 migration saying "prefetch guidance for q4-family quant profiles".

anika: I can review examples and add a smoke test that uploads results as a PR artifact.

qa-bot: CI queued: docs-lint, examples-smoke. Expected runtime ~6m.

clara: Thanks all. If reviews are green I plan to merge today and then post a short note in #eng-ml and #devex. Will also include a backport note for the migration checklist.

tom: Thanks, Clara 1 I'll eyeball the language in the problem statement.

anika: Ping me on the PR when ready and I'll attach the smoke run.

clara: Will do.
